scope: New temporary numerical analysis of a retained native baseline; no engine/detector rerun, physical ground truth or listener judgment.
window_convention: round(time*sample_rate), end excluded; whole-window mean removed.
spectral_method: Strongest symmetric-Hann rFFT magnitude bin in inclusive50..500Hz, no interpolation.
lag_method: Unwindowed mean-removed overlap-normalized dot; interior local maxima, best score, shortest lag among ties within1e-12.

delay_arithmetic.scope: Real arithmetic on nominal decimal reference, not new native Rust-f32 execution or observed pitch.
